# Travel Hacking Toolkit

> Free-first toolkit for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode). Searches award availability and cash fares, compares them by cents-per-point, uses your loyalty balances, and covers hotels, ferries, and Airbnb. Every core capability works with ZERO paid API keys; paid keys are optional upgrades.

Key concepts:
- Free-first: keyless MCP servers are the always-on base; paid keys are upgrades behind graceful fallbacks.
- Cash fares come from keyless metasearch (Skiplagged, Kiwi) plus optional Duffel.
- Award availability comes from the seats.aero MCP: cached ~60 days keyless, live/alerts with Pro.
- CPP (cents per point) = (cash price - award cash fees) / points * 100. At/above the program floor = good.
- Transfer partners map bank points to loyalty programs; effective balance = direct + ratio-adjusted transferable.

## Skills

Orchestration:
- plan-trip: guided end-to-end trip planner (the hero command).
- compare-flights: unified award + cash comparison across all sources.
- compare-hotels: hotel comparison across Trivago, Airbnb, optional LiteAPI.
- trip-calculator: cash vs points answered with CPP math.
- getting-started: first-run onboarding and setup detector.

Flights:
- seats-aero: award availability (keyless cached ~60 days; optional Pro for live/alerts).
- duffel: optional per-fare-class cash pricing.
- browser-collector: opt-in Playwright template, off by default, ToS-risky.

Loyalty:
- awardwallet: optional auto-pull of balances; falls back to user-supplied.
- transfer-partners: cheapest transfer path from card points to programs.

Reference (auto-load on context):
- flight-search-strategy: canonical free-first search workflow.
- points-valuations: CPP formula and floor/ceiling rules.
- partner-awards: which program books which airline + reachability.
- alliances: alliance membership and loyalty-program mapping.
- sweet-spots: catalog of high-value redemptions.
- fallback-and-resilience: per-tool graceful degradation.

## Data files (local, no keys)
- data/alliances.json
- data/partner-awards.json
- data/sweet-spots.json
- data/transfer-partners.json
- data/points-valuations.json
